prerequisites.title: Public home page and privacy policy
prerequisites.detail: The home page must be publicly accessible, and the privacy policy must be on the same domain and disclose how you use Google user data.

prerequisites.title: Verified domain ownership

prerequisites.title: Organization-owned Cloud project

steps.title: Choose the narrowest Gmail scopes
steps.detail: List the scopes the agent needs and prefer non-sensitive ones. Draft a written justification for each sensitive or restricted scope, including why a narrower scope is not enough.
steps.done_when: Scope list and justifications are drafted

steps.title: Configure consent screen and branding
steps.detail: In the Google API Console, enter the app name, logo, contact details, home page and privacy policy links, and declare scopes.
inputs: Home page and privacy policy URLs

steps.title: Create OAuth client and Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a Web application OAuth client. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard, then create the Composio auth config with your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: Composio auth config exists and a test connection works

steps.title: Verify domains and branding
steps.detail: Verify domains in Search Console, click Verify Branding, then Publish branding within 7 days of a compliant result.

steps.title: Prepare the demo video script
steps.detail: Draft a script showing the consent flow in English, the app name, the client ID in the address bar, and each scope's feature in use.

steps.title: Record and upload the video
steps.detail: Record the video and upload it to YouTube as Unlisted. Link it in the verification request.

steps.title: Submit data access verification
steps.detail: Submit in the OAuth Verification Center with your justifications and video, and answer any Trust & Safety follow-up emails.

steps.title: Wait for Google verification
steps.detail: Google says sensitive scope verification typically takes 3-5 business days. Follow-up questions add delay.

steps.title: Complete the security assessment
steps.detail: Required if restricted-scope data is stored on servers or transmitted. A developer reported about 2 weeks for it.

steps.title: Use managed app for prototyping
steps.detail: Until approval, test with Composio's managed Gmail app. Expect Composio branding on the consent screen.

traps.title: Apps in Testing status have a 7-day refresh token
traps.detail: Apps in Testing status have a 7-day refresh token expiration limit, which a Google Workspace administrator marking the app as Trusted can override.

traps.title: Apps in testing mode still have a tester warning
traps.detail: Apps in testing mode still have a tester warning screen, a user cap, and a limited refresh token lifetime.

traps.title: There is a limit of 100 refresh tokens per
traps.detail: There is a limit of 100 refresh tokens per Google Account per OAuth 2.0 client ID.

traps.title: Under Google Cloud organization session control, session durations can
traps.detail: Under Google Cloud organization session control, session durations can be as short as 1 to 24 hours, and the app must restart the auth session when they expire.

traps.title: Testing mode breaks long-lived connections
traps.detail: Refresh tokens expire in 7 days and only 100 listed test users are allowed in Testing status.

traps.title: Unverified public app has a 100-user cap
traps.detail: Sensitive or restricted scopes show warnings and cap total users at 100 until verified.

traps.title: Composio callback domain cannot be verified
traps.detail: Google requires verifying redirect URI domains, and you cannot verify Composio's domain. Proxy the callback through your own domain with a 302 redirect to Composio.

traps.title: Multiple OAuth clients need multiple videos
traps.detail: A 2019 report says projects with several OAuth clients need a restricted-scope demo video for each.

traps.title: Silent refresh token loss
traps.detail: Refresh tokens also die after a password change with Gmail scopes, six months of non-use, or revoked access. The 100-token-per-client limit silently invalidates the oldest.

blockers.symptom: Verification flagged as incomplete or rejected after follow-up questions
blockers.what_it_means: Google's Trust & Safety team needs more information or found a branding or scope mismatch.
blockers.what_to_do: Answer the emails, fix the listed issues, and resubmit.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft clearer scope justifications and check that links and branding match.
